drafts.title: The Kitchen Conundrum
drafts.reasoning: This scene captures the essence of the plotpoint where Hitler becomes fixated on a new threat (Ursula), leading to a dynamic exchange that sets up the upcoming conflict.
drafts.scene: A modern kitchen has been transformed into a surreal Nazi bunker with flickering lights and sounds of explosions in the background. Miles and Owen are tied to counters, while a hobo stands outside in disbelief. Ursula is now a young blonde woman, confidently injecting herself with serum vials from a nearby table.

dialogue.line: Ah, Miles, Owen! I believe you owe me an executive producer credit for my efforts here.
What? No! You're not running _my_ show!
Oh, but it's all my show now, darling. Look at this,
_lunges_, 'I will not be bested by some... beauty regime!'
'You are still the Führer, but...' she holds out a hand, '...you must learn to share.'
'Well, let's put that to the test. How do you feel about being an extra in your own film?'}
